scope: Instances of the Becoming core's retrodiction laws in the four-moment source histories. The histories, moments and decoded control records are the core's histories, dates and records; the actual history is retained by every family containing it. For every family, moment, admitted disturbances and actual target, every explanation of the earlier packet by a retained history gives the actual target exactly when every family rival giving the same reports with the other target is told apart by some control; the same for sharing at a moment. The common probe reveals sharing and the sharing course changes no more often than the history, so for every actual history in the one-change envelope whose prior and following routes agree on sharing, every retained history of that envelope agrees with it at naming; later deterioration and improvement are instances. A late control alone and controls only before and after leave unseparated rivals; the omitted excursion is the core's excursion course, read wrongly outside the one-change family and left open inside the two-change family. Correspondence to children's naming, source monitoring or trust is not checked.
